question: Does remote HE vorticity add predictive information beyond storm motion and NA vorticity/scalar wind-speed context?
remote_static_rule: exclude HE nodes inside expanded NA box latitude -2.5..52.5 and longitude 242.5..357.5
seasonal_climatology: training-only circular 31-day calendar climatology; Feb29 uses Feb28 climatology, raw missing values retained
training_weights: each storm has equal total weight, rescaled to sum to sample count
selection: validation equal-storm mean error only; test never used for model/hyperparameter selection
negative_control: 50 independent calendar-year permutations of remote fields within train/validation/test; preserve day-of-year and reselect hyperparameters on validation each time
scope_warning: NA environmental control is limited to vorticity and scalar wind speed. Multilevel steering wind and geopotential are unavailable; no causal or operational-forecast claim.
